Package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.thrift

Class TestThriftServerSSLMutualAuth

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.hbase.thrift.TestThriftServerSSLMutualAuth
@Tag("org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.ClientTests") @Tag("org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.LargeTests") public class TestThriftServerSSLMutualAuth extends Object
Exercises the role-scoped hbase.thrift.ssl.server.* configuration and the new mutual-TLS activation on the Thrift-over-HTTP transport. Complements TestThriftHttpServerSSL, which covers plain (server-only) TLS termination.
